A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sakiyan''' was present onboard the [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Whilst he was on the station, the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] was passed by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], whom was disguised as a mechanic named Jaayza and searching for her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] who was working undercover on the station.<ref name="R49" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sakiyan appeared for the first time in the [[Star Wars: Republic]] comic series in issue [[Republic 49|49]] published in [[2003]]. Titled Sacrifice, the issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]].
